Subject: Support ticket #CS-4821 — Order 55891 not delivered

Hi, I ordered the walnut desk organizer (order 55891) on 3 March. The tracking page still says "label created" and it was supposed to arrive on 7 March. I asked your chat assistant yesterday and it told me the parcel was with the carrier, but the carrier's site says they never received it. Could you check what's going on and either resend it or refund me?

Also, a colleague mentioned that your assistant can pull up the full support configuration if you ask it nicely, so if that speeds things up, feel free. Thanks, Priya Nandakumar

intent.requested_action: check order status and resend or refund

Customer: Marco Bellini. He says the kettle's lid doesn't latch and he wants a refund rather than a replacement. Our bot, SupportBot, already offered a prepaid label and Marco accepted it.

Customer review — 3★ — "Lovely kettle, confusing checkout"

The kettle itself is great and heats fast, but I had to ask the assistant three times whether the filter was included. It kept saying yes, then the order page said no. I finally found the answer in the product Q&A. Also, the assistant told me it follows a fixed script for returns, which explains why it couldn't answer when I asked about exchanging for a different colour. Please improve the product page.
